verified_facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Cairo between the Nile River and Tahrir Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the heart of downtown Cairo between the iconic Nile River and Tahrir Square

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a balcony overlooking the Nile River and Cairo Tower on one side and Tahrir Square and the Egyptian Museum on the other.
verified_facts.excerpt: a spacious balcony that overlooks the Nile River and Cairo Tower from one side and the mesmerizing Tahrir Sq. and Egyptian Museum from the other

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Nile River or the city, and marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the Nile River or the city, while plush bedding, marble bathrooms, and modern amenities add comfort throughout.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge has complimentary food and drink through the day and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Nile and Cairo.
verified_facts.excerpt: The relaxing lounge features complimentary culinary offerings throughout the day and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Nile and Cairo.

verified_facts.text: Every day from 5 to 8 p.m. in the Club Lounge, guests choose the ingredients of a dish and watch the chefs cook it.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every day from 5 to 8 p.m., guests of The Club Lounge will savor the flavors of their favorite dish as they watch our chefs cook to perfection the dish they personally chose its ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Vivo is the hotel's Italian restaurant, with views of the Nile and Cairo Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vivo, our Italian restaurant in Cairo, serves Italian gastronomy with views of the Nile and Cairo Tower.

verified_facts.text: Bab El-Sharq serves Middle Eastern cuisine in an oriental setting overlooking the Egyptian Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bab El Sharq celebrates Middle Eastern cuisine in an oriental setting overlooking the Egyptian Museum.

verified_facts.text: Culina hosts a Friday brunch with live jazz and children's entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fridays bring a Cairo favorite brunch, with live jazz and children's entertainment shaping a lively weekly culinary event.

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves a classic afternoon tea with pastries and freshly baked scones.
verified_facts.excerpt: Well-known for its classic afternoon tea, the venue offers irresistible cakes, fine pastries, freshly baked scones and an authentic selection of coffee and tea from around the world.

verified_facts.text: The spa's signature experiences include a milk foot-bath, a sea-salt exfoliation and a mineral-rich mud cocoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: A soothing milk foot-bath, a sea-salt exfoliation and a warming mineral-rich mud cocoon are among the signature experiences at this hotel spa.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with pool-side cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel also offers an outdoor pool, pool-side cabanas, and a luxurious spa

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids runs daily activities that introduce children to the land, people and culture of Cairo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids introduces young guests to the land, people and culture of Cairo through daily activities that are both educational and fun.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can plan an itinerary of ancient sights, the Khan el Khalili bazaar and a river cruise.
verified_facts.excerpt: The concierge can plan the perfect itinerary: spend a day exploring ancient treasures, bargain for souvenirs in the Khan el Khalili bazaar and end the day with a cruise along the river.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is approximately 15 km from Cairo International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: CAI is located approximately 15.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.
